test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who has fixed opinions and beliefs
solution:
The correct answer is "rigid."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Let us understand the implication of the correct option:

__
 
• Rigid: not able to or not wanting to change or be changed; fixed or stiff.

 
 
• Example: *He has a rigid posture for a gymnastic.*
 
 
 
• Evidently, the given group of words '**one who has fixed opinions and beliefs**' signifies the word 'rigid'.
 
• Therefore, the correct one-word substitute for the given group of words is '*rigid*'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us have a look at the meaning f the remaining words:

 
• Amiable: having the intention or propensity to **please**.
 
• Broad-minded: happy to** accept** beliefs and ways of life that are different from your own.
 
• Flexible: that can be changed easily; able to** bend** or move easily without breaking.
